Package com.stripe.net

Class ContextScopedStripeResponseGetter

java.lang.Object
com.stripe.net.ContextScopedStripeResponseGetter
All Implemented Interfaces:
StripeResponseGetter
public final class ContextScopedStripeResponseGetter extends Object implements StripeResponseGetter
Applies a default context and suppresses inherited account scoping without replacing the underlying requestor. Explicit request options retain their usual precedence.

For internal SDK use.
